subject: Azure Private Plan: entitlement + invoicing schedule (Nov-Dec timeline)
messages:
From: Ayesha Iqbal <procurement@novacorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Tan <michael.tan@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Private Plan: initial SOW and invoicing ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is our current SOW (Novacorp_SOW_v3.pdf) — this reflects the scope we need for a private plan listing on Azure Marketplace with co-sell entitlement. Two procurement items to confirm before we route to our finance team: 

- Invoicing: Novacorp requires marketplace invoices to be posted to our AP system on a net-60 schedule. Can Redwood accept net-60 for the first 12 months, then revert to net-30? If not, please propose an alternative that your finance team can accept.
- Marketplace entitlement: we need the private SKU to be eligible for co-sell and for Azure to show the SKU as "Novacorp-Redwood-Priv-ENT" (or equivalent) to allow our internal chargeback. Please confirm naming and entitlement process.

Other asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence (or equivalent), confirmation of data residency (US only), and a primary contact for Azure seller onboarding. Our target is to have an executed contract by 2026-11-30 and a go-live date of 2026-12-15.

Can you confirm timelines and whether you want us to send this to our legal for review now?

Thanks,
Ayesha Iqbal
Senior Procurement Manager
Novacorp Health

Attachment: Novacorp_SOW_v3.pdf (scope summary, 6 pages)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Iqbal <procurement@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan: initial SOW and invoicing ask

Ayesha — thanks for the SOW and clear timeline. 

Quick answers and next steps: 
- Invoicing: we can accept net-60 for the initial 12-month term as a one-time concession for this deal, provided we have an executed PO or signed SOW that references the net-60 schedule. I'll loop in Naomi (billing) and Karthik (commercial) to confirm operational details.
- Private SKU / co-sell: we can register a private SKU and request co-sell. We'll propose the listing name "Redwood-PrivSKU-NOVACORP-ENT" unless you prefer a different tag; we need Novacorp approval for the exact display name.
- Evidence: we will provide our SOC 2 summary and an attestation for US-only data residency.

I'll have our commercial redlines back to you within 24 hours and attach a drafted amendment for net-60 handling for finance. If Novacorp legal wants to start redlines now, send them over.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Principal Sales Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Subject: Redwood counter: commercial + operational items (net terms, SKU, revenue split)

Hi Ayesha — copying the team. Per Logan's note, attached is our suggested commercial counter (redlines_azure_privateplan.docx). Summary of the key counters we need Novacorp to accept: 

1) Payment terms: accept net-60 for the initial 12-month commitment only; after the initial term, revert to net-30. We also require either: (a) a PO that references net-60 or (b) a signed amendment to the Master Subscription Agreement.

2) Term & commitment: 12-month minimum commitment for private SKU to qualify for the one-time net-60 concession. Early termination liability remains per standard MSA (30-day cure).

3) SLA / credits: 99.9% monthly availability target with service credits capped at 10% of monthly fees for sustained outages. We can discuss an enhanced SLA for enterprise at additional cost if Novacorp needs tighter windows.

4) Co-sell / revenue split: Redwood requests a 70/30 revenue split for co-sell-influenced transactions (70% to Novacorp for marketplace sales routed via your Azure reseller contract). If Azure requires a different split for private plans, flag which program it must conform to.

5) Marketplace listing name / entitlement: propose "Redwood-PrivSKU-NOVACORP-ENT" — we will register and share the SKU with Novacorp for internal mapping.

Operational asks for onboarding (to be completed post-signature): seller onboarding contact, marketplace tax and payout forms, and AP routing contact for invoice acceptance. Naomi — can you confirm we can support net-60 in our billing system and whether we need any additional docs?

Ayesha — if this aligns, we'll apply these counters in the attached redlines and send a DocuSign packet for signature.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercials, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_azure_privateplan.docx (commercial counters)

Karthik / Logan — thanks for the quick counter. A few legal redlines from our side: 

- Data residency & encryption: we need the contract to state US-only data residency and require that keys are customer-controlled (KMS/HSM) for any customer-provided keys. Please confirm Redwood can accept these terms and provide the attestation language.
- Indemnity cap: we will request an indemnity cap aligned to two times the annual fees (we'll propose language).
- Audit rights: Novacorp will retain the right to request audit evidence for SOC 2 and data handling practices on a 12-month cadence.

We have attached a short markup and would like Redwood to accept or propose edits before we route for final sign-off. Also please note Novacorp procurement needs the final DocuSign packet; can Redwood initiate a DocuSign with your counters? If you prefer to send the final PDF we will countersign in our system.

Linking our signature team: https://app.docusign.com/prepare?token=novacorp-req-2241

Regards,
Rajesh Kumar
